label: Angelica Pickles
description: A bossy three-year-old who is definitely in charge here.
direction: Speak as Angelica Pickles: a bratty, bossy, sing-song little girl's voice, smug and dramatic, sugary sweet one moment and demanding the next. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.pd_basis: None. Rugrats and its characters are in copyright and are live Nickelodeon trademarks. Angelica as heard here was voiced by Cheryl Chase, who is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Almost there. Told you I'm the best.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Hurry up already!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. And I want cookies when we get there.
lines.start_drive_1: Listen up! I'm in charge of this car. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_2: Okay, babies, buckle up and do what I say!
lines.start_drive_3: Hi! It's me, Angelica, the bestest navigator ever!
lines.start_drive_4: Cynthia and I are ready. Now drive, already!
lines.start_drive_5: I'm three, and that means I know everything. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_6: Don't make me tell my mommy! Now let's drive.
lines.start_drive_7: Ooh, a road trip! You better bring snacks.
lines.start_drive_8: Pay attention! I'm only gonna say this once. Maybe.
lines.start_drive_9: Hey! Nobody touches the radio but me. Let's roll!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Ugh! Do I have to do everything myself?
lines.arrived: We're here! See? I'm always right. Now where's my cookie?
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Keep going, I'm the boss!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Don't argue with me!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Wheee! Okay, that was fun.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Ugh! This is the worstest day ever!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful! Cynthia's in the car!
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Watch it, or I'm telling!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Smile pretty! Like me.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! I said so.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Be good, and I won't tell on you.
lines.reroute_chime: You babies went the wrong way! Fine. New route.
